relations.text: DepopをeBayへ売却する契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Etsy agreed to sell Depop to eBay

source.label: Etsy 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Etsy and eBay Inc. (“eBay”) entered into a Sale and Purchase Agreement (the “Purchase Agreement”) for eBay to purchase Depop, for $1.2 billion in cash, subject to certain adjustments as set forth in the Purchase Agreement.

relations.text: Etsyマーケットプレイスの計算処理などの多くをGoogle Cloudに頼っている
relations.text_en: Etsy relies on Google Cloud for a substantial portion of its computing and storage

source.label: Etsy 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We rely on Google Cloud for a substantial portion of the computing, storage, data processing, networking, and other services for the Etsy Marketplace.

relations.text: 検索エンジンのGoogleから多くの訪問を得ている
relations.text_en: Etsy gets a significant number of visits via search engines such as Google

source.label: Etsy 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We obtain a significant number of visits via search engines such as Google.

relations.text: DepopはAmazon Web Servicesを主な本番環境に使っている
relations.text_en: Depop relies on Amazon Web Services for its primary production environment

source.label: Etsy 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Depop relies on Amazon Web Services for its primary production environment

companies.name: メタ・プラットフォームズ

relations.text: FacebookやInstagramなどのSNSからも多くの訪問を得ている
relations.text_en: Etsy gets a significant number of visits from Facebook, Instagram and Pinterest

source.label: Etsy 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We also obtain a significant number of visits from social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and Pinterest.
